The figure is a line chart displaying trade data over time. The x-axis represents years from 2020 to 2023, with tick labels at yearly intervals. The x-axis scale is linear. The y-axis on the left side represents values in billions of US dollars, ranging from 0 to 400, with tick labels at 50-unit intervals. The y-axis on the right side represents a balance, also in billions of US dollars, ranging from -200 to 400, with tick labels at 100-unit intervals. There are three data series presented as lines. A maroon line, labeled "Exporte (linke Skala)", starts at approximately 180 in 2020, dips to around 140 in early 2021, rises to approximately 260 in late 2022, and ends at approximately 310 in 2023. A blue line, labeled "Importe (linke Skala)", begins at approximately 220 in 2020, decreases to around 180 in early 2021, fluctuates between approximately 220 and 280 from 2021 to 2023, and concludes at approximately 340 in 2023. A shaded blue area, labeled "Saldo (rechte Skala)", extends from 2020 to 2023, fluctuating between approximately -100 and 100, and ending at approximately 0 in 2023.
